description: This Java class 'ProductPrice' models the pricing details for products within an e-commerce system. It defines properties such as price amount, price type, special price periods, availability, and descriptions. It also includes annotations for ORM mapping using JPA/Hibernate, indicating its role as an entity class in database operations.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: Entity class representing product pricing details with fields for amount, special pricing, type, availability, and descriptions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product price.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the product price.

methods.name: getProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the main price amount of the product.

methods.name: setProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Sets the main price amount of the product.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date for a special price period, with cloning to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for a special price period, cloning to manage mutability.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date for a special price period, with cloning to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for a special price period, cloning to manage mutability.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the special price amount, if any.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Sets the special price amount.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with this price.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Indicates whether this is the default price.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets whether this is the default price.

methods.name: getProductAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves the product availability associated with this price.

methods.name: setProductAvailability
methods.description: Associates a product availability with this price.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier for this price.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for this price.

methods.name: getProductPriceType
methods.description: Retrieves the price type (e.g., one-time).

methods.name: setProductPriceType
methods.description: Sets the price type.
